ov: A cat-sized relative of kangaroos and wallabies from southwestern Australia. It is herbivorous and mainly nocturnal, and lives mostly on Rottnest and Bald islands, which have no foxes or cats. It is listed as vulnerable.

why.ac: Mainly nocturnal, like many of its kangaroo relatives.

rg: Southwestern Australia: Rottnest Island, Bald Island and scattered spots between Perth and Albany.
fx: Quokkas do not really smile: the grin is just the shape of their face.
